name: Dominate Person

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a Humanoid you can see within range

upcast.text: Concentration lasts up to 10 minutes with a level 6 slot, 1 hour with level 7 and 8 hours with level 8+.

summary: A Humanoid makes a Wis save or is Charmed and obeys you; it saves again whenever it takes damage.
text: It has Advantage on the save if you or your allies are fighting it. While Charmed it follows your commands; you can take a Magic action to control its next action precisely.
